item.title: 214 Starkon
item.description: 214 · Starkon Founded in 3 AM. One of the three kingdoms of the Trois Re, which it calls the Drei Kunig. Capital: Hekatania.

item.title: 216 Regno
item.description: 216 · Regno Founded in 3 AM, the same day as Mathair. The third kingdom of the Trois Re, which it calls the Tre Regis. Capital: Caragna.

item.description: Your patron is Ignatius, who was a mortal and is now the god of Ambition. He is the only one, so there is no other source for this pact.

item.title: Warlock Scholarch
item.description: Your patron is one of the three Scholarchs of Temporalis, who are also the three sphinxes: It That Was, It That Is, and It That Will Be.
